title: schorm Lesson Frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter block at the top of a lesson markdown file (content/<module-id>/<file>.md). The markdown body below the frontmatter is the lesson content; it may embed media via {{audio src="..."}} / {{video src="..."}} shortcodes and standard markdown images. Rule the schema cannot express: 'module' must match a module id declared in course.yml, and 'id' must be listed in that module's 'items' array (except scenario scenes, which are discovered automatically).

id.description: Unique lesson identifier: letters, digits, hyphens and underscores only. Used as the SCO id and output filename (<id>.html).

title.description: Human-readable lesson title, shown in the LMS and as the page heading.

module.description: Id of the module this lesson belongs to. MUST match a module id declared in course.yml.

type.description: Optional content-type marker. If present it must be exactly "lesson".

order.description: Optional ordering hint (reserved for future ordering logic; item order in course.yml governs today).

duration.description: Estimated lesson duration in minutes. Informational, stored in lesson metadata.

objectives.description: Learning objectives. Informational, stored in lesson metadata.

ending.description: Scenario mode only: marks this scene as an ending of the choose-your-own-adventure graph.

mastery.description: Scenario mode only: the SCORM score (0-1) reported when the learner reaches this ending scene.
